---
name: sprint-review-retro
description: Produce the SPRINT-<n>-REVIEW.md with delivered vs planned work, velocity, demo notes and retrospective actions. Use at the end of each sprint.
---

# Sprint review and retro

Write `docs/plans/<slug>/SPRINT-<n>-REVIEW.md`:

1. Sprint goal and whether it was met
2. Planned vs done table (story, points, status, QA verdict)
3. Velocity (done points) and trend; carry-over and why
4. Demo notes: what to show, how to try it
5. Defects found/open (link bug reports)
6. Risks and plan changes (update sprint plan and risk register)
7. Retro: went well, to improve, action items (owner, due sprint)
8. Next sprint proposal and decisions needed from the user

Then pause for user feedback unless told to continue autonomously.
